design.advance: At least three useful added feathered groups across both editor families, at most two additional ordinary groups and four misplaced edit flags per quality.
design.calibration: Separate operating points on 12 ordinary source groups. Use strict exceedance of second largest group maximum or minimum point.
design.comparator: Current JPEG aligned luma on exact same encoded bytes.
design.deficit: Parent-child coupling lower than the surrounding two-cell ring, with a minimum deficit in both adjacent scale pairs.
design.held: Separate retained 12- and 16-photo F5 panels, previously exposed under other methods. Original, same-site local blur, tone, copy and opaque overlay, global resize and second JPEG, plus matched local/global processing when provided.
design.joint_statistics: Kendall tau-b on absolute responses and signed polarity coupling with marginal centering
design.paired_control: Subtract mean coupling of the exact same sampled coarse values cyclically shifted by 2 or 3 positions on either axis.
design.support: Both scale pairs need enough cells in core and ring. Exclude cells with 15% clipped or mean parent band activity under 1.5.
